scope: Nine standard normals, one 6H directional normal and one forward throw per pilot. Specials, EX, supers, back throw, range, hitboxes and pushback are excluded.

frame_convention.late_contact_rule: Add the 0-based active contact offset to the nominal advantage if no other timing changes.
frame_convention.throw_exception: Use the explicit capture and release fields; ordinary hitstun and blockstun formulas do not apply.

guard_contract.high: Not used in these 66 rows; high attacks need a separately defined crouching-whiff/hurtbox rule.
guard_contract.aerial_normals: All j.L/j.M/j.H in this pilot set are overhead, not mid. Air guard remains possible.
guard_contract.anti_air_2H: All 2H are mid and air-unblockable, not low.

arithmetic_validation.nature: Static arithmetic checks only. No gameplay, collision, renderer or engine test performed.
